fields.description: The server key stays on the server. The browser key goes to the Near Me map.
fields.label: Google Keys

fields.description: Stays on the server for address lookups. While blank, address search finds nothing and maps use OpenStreetMap.
fields.label: Server Key

fields.description: Looks up a sample place with the saved server key to prove the key and billing work. Save the page first.
fields.label: Check Connection

fields.description: Sent to the browser for the Near Me map, so limit it to this site. While blank, Near Me says it is not set up.
fields.label: Browser Key

fields.description: Google needs this to draw the grouped pins on the Near Me map. While blank, Google's plain demo map is drawn.
fields.label: Map ID

fields.description: Google always looks up addresses. This field is shown for reference only, and it cannot be changed here.
fields.label: Address Provider

fields.description: The two-letter country code, such as IN, that address search keeps to. While blank, it searches the world.
fields.label: Search Country

fields.description: Google maps fall back to OpenStreetMap until a server key is saved and the switch is on.
fields.label: Map Display

fields.description: Picks who draws the small maps on task cards. Blank uses OpenStreetMap. Google needs a saved server key.
fields.label: Thumbnail Map

fields.description: How close the small map pictures sit to the pin. A higher number shows a closer view. Blank uses level 16.
fields.label: Thumbnail Zoom

fields.description: Picks who draws the larger map in task pop-ups. Blank uses Google, or OpenStreetMap while there is no key.
fields.label: Pop-up Map

fields.description: Where OpenStreetMap maps fetch their tiles from. It must start with https. Blank uses tile.openstreetmap.org.
fields.label: OpenStreetMap Tile URL

fields.description: Checks that in-person visits happen at the doctor's clinic.
fields.label: Visit Checks

fields.description: Lead groups whose in-person visits must happen near the clinic pin, each with a distance. Empty checks none.
fields.label: Tracked Lead Groups

fields.description: The role that may move a clinic pin once it is set. System Manager can always do this. Blank allows only them.
fields.label: Pin Override Role
